app.title: MoCoCo
home.heading: Projects
home.subtitle: Co-create a movie commentary video with AI, stage by stage.
home.empty: No projects yet. Create one to get started.
home.delete_confirm: Delete project "{title}"? This removes all its files.
newp.title: New project
newp.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, - or _. Used as the folder name.
newp.film_from_computer: Choose a movie from your computer
newp.film_upload_hint: Creating the project uploads the movie to the website server for this project. Large files may take a few minutes.
newp.brief_placeholder: One paragraph describing what this commentary should cover. Leave empty and AI will improvise from the film itself.
wizard.busy: Another stage is already running for this project.
setup.title: Title
setup.shots_hint: Hover a frame for its caption; click to preview the clip.
setup.no_shots: Run this step to detect shots and generate keyframes and captions.
script.mismatch: Paragraph counts differ ({a} vs {b}); translation or segmentation may fail.
script.resegment_hint: Script text changed since segmentation; segments may be stale. Re-run Segment.
script.confirm_overwrite: A script already exists. Draft again and overwrite it?
script.no_units: Run Segment to break the script into units.
script.placeholder: Write the commentary here, one paragraph per unit, separated by a blank line.
shots.heading: Shots
shots.hint: Click a candidate to choose or unchoose it for this unit, then save.
shots.no_candidates: Run this step to retrieve candidate shots for each unit.
cut.heading: Cut
cut.hint: Reorder, trim, or remove clips within each unit.
cut.no_timeline: Run this step to assemble a rough cut from the chosen shots.
voice.heading: Voice
voice.no_langs: No voice languages configured for this project.
voice.upload_hint: Uploading your own recording replaces TTS narration. It must read the script in the same order, start to finish.
voice.no_timing: Run this step to synthesize narration and compute per-unit timing.
export.heading: Export
export.no_output: Run this step to render the final video.
